resources.string: Set independent overall and category limits for each calendar month. Future months can be planned; limits do not roll over automatically.
A ₹0 limit is a real budget. Remove a budget to leave its scope without a limit.
This changes only this limit. To use another month or category, add a separate budget.
Category limits still apply independently. They do not add up to an overall allowance.
Warnings appear here from 80%% of the limit. Refunds reduce spending in the month received, so remaining can exceed the limit. Transfers and adjustments are excluded.

Only limits are copied, with new records. Recorded transactions, source-month limits and existing destination limits stay unchanged.
This removes only the monthly limit. Recorded transactions and limits for other months remain intact.
Copy complete. Existing limits were preserved.
